election: 2024 French legislative election (2nd constituency for French residents abroad)
detail: Won the second round against the left-wing coalition candidate in the constituency covering Latin America and the Caribbean.

election: 2023 partial legislative election (re-run, 2nd constituency for French residents abroad)
detail: Re-run ordered by the Constitutional Council after the 2022 result was annulled over a technical failure in internet voting. Caroit won the re-run and returned to the Assembly on 17 April 2023.

election: 2022 French legislative election (2nd constituency for French residents abroad)
detail: First elected in June 2022. The result was annulled by the Constitutional Council in January 2023 due to a technical fault in the internet voting system, triggering a 2023 re-run.

election: Election of Councillors of French Nationals Abroad
detail: Elected as a councillor of French nationals abroad, serving until July 2022.
